claim_classes: Hotbit customers with remaining platform balances at shutdown
notes: Internal account redemption is not equivalent to an on-chain or external-platform withdrawal. The 21 June 2023 withdrawal deadline is preserved as an instruction, not as evidence that every customer completed withdrawal or received every asset owed.
